goal: log-notify v0.1: Rust daemon that tails configured log files, matches per-source regexes, and emits freedesktop notifications through D-Bus with reliable bounded delivery.
active_goals: Documentation, architecture, ADRs, plan, and decisions complete (2026-11-26).
CI copied from Ursine and adapted: containerized verify job, test gate, static analysis, docs lint, duplicates, SBOM, static-musl release.
Rust scaffold and default config in place; T1/T2 complete. v0.1 behavior starts at T3.
decisions: Rust stable, edition 2024, single binary, Linux only, synchronous main loop, inotify-driven with no polling.
Read logs only; no native tool hooks; no replay or persistence; every source starts at end of file.
Default config is data: sources, patterns, templates, urgency, cooldown, and queue capacity are TOML. No tool-specific code.
TOML config with serde; compile every regex at startup; fail loud with file, line, and reason.
Missing log source at startup: warn, watch nearest existing ancestor directory, continue. Re-resolve when intermediate directories appear. Permission denied is fatal.
Main loop never calls D-Bus. Dedicated notifier worker with a bounded per-source queue: default 10, range 1..=100.
Queue overflow drops the oldest event of that source and logs it. No durable spool; pending events are lost on restart.
Notification failures retry 3 times with 1/2/4 s backoff and a 5 s zbus method timeout; missing service or exhausted retries drop and log.
Dropped-event log defaults to /var/log/log-notify.log; if unwritable, warn once and fall back to stderr.
zbus 6.5 async API driven by zbus::block_on in the worker; no async runtime.
Non-UTF-8 lines use lossy conversion. Over-cap lines keep the capped prefix, discard the rest, and match once.
XDG_RUNTIME_DIR unset: use /run/user/<uid> if present, else exit with a clear error.
--once exits after the first regex match is processed; normal mode waits for delivery or drop outcome. Config paths: /etc/log-notify/log-notify.toml, then ~/.config/log-notify/log-notify.toml.
SIGHUP config reload deferred to v0.2; v0.1 requires restart.

CI adapted from Ursine: one containerized verify job, Alpine image, clippy-driven test gate, static/SAST/deps/duplicates/SBOM/docs gates, tag-driven static-musl release. No Ursine Nix/GUI/installer jobs.
Host toolchain is not used: every gate runs in the container through scripts/dev.sh or GitHub Actions.
Rust scaffold uses edition 2024 and the direct inotify 0.11.x crate; daemon behavior is not implemented yet.
risks: GitHub Actions has not run the new workflow yet; only the local container verify is proven.
Queue overflow or permanent notification-service absence drops events; every drop is logged, but delivery is not guaranteed.
Pending in-memory events are lost on restart by design.
A retry after an uncertain reply can duplicate a notification. Accepted: duplicate over silent loss.
/var/log/log-notify.log may not be writable by a user-session service; stderr fallback is implemented.
Session-memory scripts fail on this host with Nix libc relocation errors; context-mode ctx_* tools and this state file are the working alternative.
Template Node/JS files remain in the repo because the OpenCode harness uses them; they are not the project stack.
